zopfli 1.0.3 (tag zopfli-1.0.3), https://github.com/google/zopfli, by
Google (Lode Vandevenne, Jyrki Alakuijala and the CONTRIBUTORS): from its
release's source tarball zopfli-zopfli-1.0.3.tar.gz (sha256
e955a7739f71af37ef3349c4fa141c648e8775bceb2195be07e86f8e638814bd), only
the files its deflate is built from (src/zopfli, without the gzip and zlib
containers and the command), copied unmodified. Apache License 2.0
(COPYING).

PPA uses it for deflate recipe kind 2, encoder 3 (doc/PREFLATE.md): a
stream zopfli wrote (zopflipng: 15 iterations under 200,000 bytes, 5 over;
advpng -z4; zopfli's own command) is rebuilt by calling it again with the
stream's options. pas/ppazopc.c builds these files with no C runtime and
with the same bits on every platform (SSE2 doubles, and log() replaced by
a correctly rounded one of PPA's). zopfli's master branch (df1517d, 2021)
has the same deflate.

Do not patch these files here: a new release comes in whole, replacing
this directory, and only if it gives the same bytes (or as a new variant).
